groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.774% and the 10Y at 4.992%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -1.54% over five sessions and -4.20% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.00% at about $92.76, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-29/100, 71% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in Nasdaq breadth is weak. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is +2.31% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -29/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: open -20 → now -29 (deteriorated 9 points).

The main live drivers are Breadth are a headwind: After-hours · After-hours breadth: 20/98 advancing (20%) · 78 declining · 0 flat. It changed from positive to negative after the baseline snapshot. Semiconductors are supportive: Previous regular-session close · SOX +5.66% | Nasdaq +1.60% | SOX vs Nasdaq +4.06 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +4.41 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +3.22 pp. Mega-caps are a headwind: After-hours · 7-stock basket -1.28% | 3/7 positive | QQQ -0.89% | relative -0.39 pp. It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth negative).

What would change the view: improvement would require further easing in the 10Y toward/below 4.95%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by a renewed 10Y break above roughly 5.05%, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
